pair_order: odd cases current,candidate; even cases candidate,current; each exactly once

arm_interpretation.current: current dependent generation with full part_definitions in the same admitted Worker/provider as candidate
arm_interpretation.candidate: one preregistered display-source output-contract candidate; canonical conversion fixed before first public measurement

evaluation.quality: candidate 4/4 valid closed contracts and exact/minimal complete NEW label/kind/quantity tuples; NEW0 must remain empty
evaluation.paired_gain: both responses valid; current semantic error to candidate exact; require at least one gain among the two explicit-name cases
evaluation.regression_and_controls: zero observed semantic regressions across all four; standard-name and NEW0 candidate exact; all invalid/HTTP failures retained in the eight-cell denominator
evaluation.validity_not_semantic_gain: contract-rate changes reported separately, never counted as semantic paired wins
evaluation.invalid_not_negative_proof: invalid or ineligible pairs never become gain, semantic tie, or NO_EFFECT evidence
evaluation.scope_limit: finite held-out extraction observations only; no ordinary UI, V/Goal, general Type efficacy or unique internal-cause claim

release_conditions: Public candidate 4/4 exact with zero contract rejection, at least one valid paired improvement on the known explicit-name cases, and zero control regression.
Public and fresh use the same admitted frozen candidate/conversion, provider/model request settings/full definitions; packaging changes are not precision gains.
No measurement-source, normalization, oracle or criteria changes after first public slot; no fresh payload release before the public gate.
Inputs-only release first; oracle only after strict physical stop and accounting of that fresh phase.
private_handling: inputs, oracle, private validation and authoring remain undisclosed; no old unused seal enumeration or reuse
